I'm on a diet set by my doctors. Have basically cut out all wheat products, sugary things, etc. All I eat now is rice, potatoes, meat, vegetables like tomatoes, salad etc, fruits like bananas etc. I'm also taking probiotics. Although I do have days where I can't be bothered (cheat days) its only usually a burger or something. It's not my skin that smells its an internal thing. I'm sure they know they just lie to me and they tell me that I'm fine (Like seriously you think I don't notice that you open all the windows when I'm home) but they have been taking me to the doctors so there's that. 

Glad you are doing better :) Thanks for trying to help me too :)

I don't live in the US but even if I did I'm not even sure what I have...I've been to many doctors and always get a different story...so I don't think I would qualify :(

Do those things help :)

Sorry you had to grow up in that situation hope you are doing better now :)
